name: label_colon_not_available
text: Sponsorship: Not Available. Candidates must be able to work in the U.S. without restriction.
reason: Spec: must report NO_SPONSORSHIP "including when the JD states it as a labelled field in a details block, e.g. 'Sponsorship: Not Available'".

name: label_colon_visa_no
text: Visa Sponsorship: No. This is a 12-month contract engagement.
reason: Spec example: "'Visa Sponsorship: No'" is NO_SPONSORSHIP.

name: label_dash_none
text: Sponsorship - None. This is a direct-hire role based in Austin.
reason: Spec example: "'Sponsorship - None'" is NO_SPONSORSHIP.

name: label_colon_not_offered
text: Immigration Sponsorship: Not offered for this position.
reason: Spec example: "'Immigration Sponsorship: Not offered'" is NO_SPONSORSHIP.

name: label_en_dash_not_available
text: Visa Sponsorship – Not Available
reason: Labelled field stating non-sponsorship, with en dash separator, is NO_SPONSORSHIP per "including when the JD states it as a labelled field in a details block".

name: label_lowercase_visa_no
text: visa sponsorship: no. we are unable to sponsor work visas.
reason: Spec: capitalisation does not matter; "'Visa Sponsorship: No'" and "We are unable to sponsor" are both NO_SPONSORSHIP.

name: sentence_unable_to_sponsor
text: We are unable to sponsor employment visas for this position.
reason: Spec: "Plain-sentence refusals ('We are unable to sponsor', ...) are NO_SPONSORSHIP as well."

name: sentence_f1_opt_cpt_ineligible
text: F-1 / OPT / CPT students are not eligible for this role.
reason: Spec: "'F-1 / OPT / CPT students are not eligible'" is a plain-sentence refusal that is NO_SPONSORSHIP.

name: sentence_no_visa_sponsorship
text: This position offers no visa sponsorship.
reason: Spec: "'no visa sponsorship'" is NO_SPONSORSHIP.

name: sentence_without_sponsorship_future
text: Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship now or in the future.
reason: Spec: "'without sponsorship now or in the future'" is NO_SPONSORSHIP.

name: sentence_sponsorship_not_available
text: Sponsorship is not available for this role.
reason: Spec: "'sponsorship is not available'" is listed among plain-sentence refusals that are NO_SPONSORSHIP.

name: conocophillips_other_than_employer_school
text: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis for anyone other than current employer and/or education institution.
reason: Spec: this exact phrasing "excludes F-1 CPT" and yields NO_SPONSORSHIP.

name: details_block_multiple_fields
text: Details: Location – Houston, TX. Employment Type – Full-time. Visa Sponsorship – None.
reason: Spec: labelled field inside a details block stating non-sponsorship is NO_SPONSORSHIP.

name: sentence_will_not_sponsor_h1b
text: Please note we will not sponsor H-1B visas for this position.
reason: Spec: must report NO_SPONSORSHIP "whenever the employer says it will not sponsor a work visa".

name: label_visa_yes
text: Visa Sponsorship: Yes. We support H-1B transfers and new petitions.
reason: Spec: must NOT report NO_SPONSORSHIP when "the employer offers sponsorship ('Visa Sponsorship: Yes', ...)".

name: label_sponsorship_available
text: Sponsorship: Available for candidates who qualify.
reason: Spec: must NOT report NO_SPONSORSHIP when sponsorship is offered ("'Sponsorship: Available'").

name: label_dash_yes
text: Sponsorship - Yes. Relocation assistance is provided.
reason: Spec: an employer offering sponsorship must not be flagged, whether as labelled field or plain sentence.

name: sentence_immigration_sponsorship_available
text: Immigration sponsorship is available for this position.
reason: Spec: must NOT report NO_SPONSORSHIP when "the employer offers sponsorship".

name: sentence_will_sponsor_h1b
text: We will sponsor H-1B visas for the right candidate.
reason: Spec: "'we will sponsor H-1B visas'" is explicitly a non-NO_SPONSORSHIP case.

name: company_sponsored_medical_plan
text: This role includes a company-sponsored medical plan, plus dental and vision coverage.
reason: Spec: must NOT report NO_SPONSORSHIP when "'sponsor' means something else: a 'company-sponsored medical plan'".

name: event_sponsorship_opportunities
text: Our team manages event sponsorship opportunities across the region.
reason: Spec: "'event sponsorship opportunities'" is a non-visa use of sponsor and must not be flagged.

name: sponsorship_ticketing_hospitality
text: Experience in sponsorship, ticketing and hospitality sales is preferred.
reason: Spec: "'sponsorship, ticketing and hospitality sales'" must not be reported as NO_SPONSORSHIP.

name: executive_sponsor_mentorship
text: You will be paired with an executive sponsor for mentorship during onboarding.
reason: Spec: "'executive sponsor'" is a different meaning of sponsor and must not be flagged.

name: opt_out_ai_screening
text: Candidates can opt out of AI-assisted resume screening at any time.
reason: Spec: must NOT report NO_SPONSORSHIP when "the text says the applicant can 'opt out' / 'opt in' of something (AI screening, text messages) — 'opt' here is not OPT".

name: opt_in_text_messages
text: You may opt in to receive text message updates about your application.
reason: Spec: "'opt in'" of text messages is not the OPT visa program and must not be flagged.

name: e_verify_only
text: We participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility.
reason: Spec: must NOT report NO_SPONSORSHIP when "the text only mentions U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services / E-Verify".

name: uscis_form_i9_mention
text: You will complete Form I-9 with U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services on your first day.
reason: Spec: a mere mention of "U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services" is not a sponsorship refusal.

name: eeo_citizenship_status
text: We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all applicants regardless of citizenship status.
reason: Spec: must NOT report NO_SPONSORSHIP for "an EEO statement about citizenship status".
